violations.reason: tests/accessibility/theme-contrast.test.ts defines an isolated in-memory fixture class RuntimeThemeManager and static themeVariants tokens instead of integrating with or testing real DesignTokenCompiler logic. It fakes theme switching and validates only WCAG AA (4.5:1) on slate palettes, failing to verify the mandated WCAG AAA (7:1 minimum) contrast floor and Obsidian tokens (#08090C, #11141C) required by the client specification.
